O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain. As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
They pleaded with Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.”
to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?
From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?
But Moses told the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORDʼs salvation, which He will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
For truly my words are free of falsehood; one perfect in knowledge is with you.
Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
